description: This file defines the internal class ClientGrainContext within the Orleans framework, implementing interfaces related to grain context management, extension handling, and lifecycle operations. It manages components, extensions, and references for client-side grain contexts, including extension registration, retrieval, and lifecycle methods.

classes.name: ClientGrainContext
classes.description: Represents a client-side grain context in Orleans, managing components, extensions, and references, and providing mechanisms for extension registration, retrieval, and lifecycle management.

methods.name: GetComponent
methods.description: Retrieves a component of specified type from the context or activates it via dependency injection.

methods.name: SetComponent
methods.description: Sets or removes a component of specified type within the context.

methods.name: GetOrSetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves an existing extension or creates and registers a new one if it does not exist.

methods.name: GetExtension
methods.description: Retrieves a registered extension of specified type, throws if not found.

methods.name: ReceiveMessage
methods.description: Method placeholder for receiving messages, not implemented.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates the grain context with request data.

methods.name: Deactivate
methods.description: Deactivates the grain context with a specified reason.

methods.name: Rehydrate
methods.description: Rehydrates the context from a given rehydration state, disposing of the context if applicable.

methods.name: Migrate
methods.description: Placeholder for migration logic, not supported in this implementation.
